# Irha Apparels — Expanded Public Website Summary

## Company positioning

Irha Apparels provides B2B custom apparel manufacturing services from Sialkot, Pakistan for brands, wholesalers, importers, retailers, clubs and private-label buyers through OEM, ODM and made-to-requirement apparel programs.

The website is for business inquiries rather than consumer retail. Fixed prices are not published. Commercial details are confirmed after the buyer shares product type, quantity, materials, construction, branding, packaging, destination and target schedule.

Irha Apparels does not claim factories or offices in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia or New Zealand. Manufacturing is based in Sialkot, Pakistan. Buyers may request an appointment-based live factory-view video call; availability and viewing scope must be confirmed.

Target-market pages describe sourcing requirements and commercial intent. They are not proof of historic exports, prior customers or an established client base in those markets.

## Public business verification

The official Sialkot Chamber of Commerce & Industry member directory associates IRHA APPARELS with reference/member identifier A-101267. This is presented as business-identity evidence only. The website does not use that directory reference to claim a certificate issue date, renewal date, committee status, product certification, factory certification, export history or production capacity.

Current public contact authority:

- Email: info@irhaapparels.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +92 320 411 0066
- Location: Sialkot, Pakistan

## Product divisions

1. Bavarian & Trachten Wear
2. Premium Leather Apparel
3. Custom Sportswear
4. Streetwear & Activewear
5. Leisurewear & Nightwear

The public catalogue is organised by main category, relevant audience or buyer group, product type and individual product page.

### Bavarian and Trachten wear

- Lederhosen in short, knee-length and long formats
- Dirndl dresses, blouses and aprons
- Trachten shirts, vests, jackets and Janker programs
- Suspenders, belts, hats, socks and related accessories

### Premium leather apparel

- Biker and motorcycle-inspired jackets
- Bomber and fashion leather jackets
- Leather vests and waistcoats
- Custom lining, hardware, labels, patches and packaging options subject to the product brief

### Sportswear

- Football, rugby, basketball, cricket and hockey uniforms
- Tracksuits, warm-up sets and training wear
- Club, school and distributor program options
- Team artwork, names, numbers and repeat-order references where agreed

### Streetwear and activewear

- T-shirts, including heavyweight programs
- Hoodies, sweatshirts and fleece sets
- Tracksuits, activewear and branded basics
- Embroidery, screen print, DTF and other decoration subject to product review

### Leisurewear and nightwear

- Buyer-specified leisure and sleepwear programs
- Fabrics, trims, labels and packaging confirmed per inquiry

## Private-label capabilities

Publicly described capabilities can include custom cut and sew, embroidery, printing, sublimation where appropriate, woven labels, care labels, size labels, hang tags, buyer-specified packaging and shipment preparation. Exact capability, process location and suitability depend on the product brief and are confirmed during requirement review.

A private-label order may include:

1. Product and material review
2. Sample or pre-production approval
3. Measurement, construction and decoration checkpoints
4. Buyer-approved labels and packaging
5. Written production, shipping and commercial terms

## Commercial accuracy policy

The public website does not treat sample copy, concept images or automated calculations as binding quotations. Materials, MOQ, pricing, production timing, shipping method, documentation and compliance evidence are confirmed for each buyer requirement.

Do not infer that every product uses the same MOQ, production time, material or certification. Do not infer certification status from educational content. Standards such as ISO, OEKO-TEX, SEDEX, WRAP, BSCI, GOTS, GRS, REACH, SGS, Intertek or CE may be discussed only in an order-specific or educational context unless current documentary evidence proves an applicable credential.

## Buyer trust

Buyer verification should focus on the published business identity, SCCI directory/member reference A-101267, current contact channels, written quotation, approved specification and program-specific evidence. An appointment-based live factory call may be requested as a verification step, subject to availability and viewing scope.
